C0738.title: Tax Official Colludes with Criminals in Tax-Related Offense Exposed
C0738.summary: On July 28, 2023, tax authorities released five typical tax-related illegal cases and exposed one case involving a tax official colluding with external criminals. The official knowingly violated the law, conspiring with outsiders in bribery and collusion between government and business, ultimately receiving a two-year prison sentence.

references.title: Tax Official Knowingly Breaks Law, Bribery and Corruption, Official-Business Collusion Leads to 'Insider', Sentenced to 2 Years
